_comment: 3D premixed hydrogen burner: a mixing tube discharging through a
sudden expansion into a confinement chamber. The step at z = 0 is what
anchors the flame -- the recirculation behind it feeds hot products
back into the incoming premixed stream.
The 34 mm mixing tube is the dimension the AHEAD case README states;
the chamber follows its sampleDict, whose lines run to +-50 mm and
whose highest station is 90 mm. The injector internals -- the swirl
slits, the dilution holes, the 16 fuel ports -- are not resolved: by
the tube exit the stream is premixed, and that exit condition is what
About 40 000 cells, as all four cases of this set are: the GPU this
is benchmarked on carries of order 10 000 threads at once, so a
smaller mesh would leave most of a batch idle and time the launch
